wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 07-005 aggregates the HUD-message state + per-tic functions (createHudMessageState, hudMessageStart, requestHudMessageRefresh, tickHudMessages) + the Doom 1 map-name resolver (getDoom1MapName) plus the 4-second timeout constants into a single src/vanilla re-export facade for the HUD pass. The read-only src/ui/hudMessages.ts already implements vanilla hu_stuff.c semantics; pure barrel + frozen manifest, no source modification.
